(8) The proceedings of the meeting of the Monetary Policy
Board shall be confidential.
(9)  The  Monetary  Policy  Board  shall  publish  the
resolution adopted by it after the conclusion of every meeting
of the Monetary Policy Board with an explanation of recent
economic  developments  and  economic  outlook  which
underpins  such  resolution.
(10)  The  Monetary  Policy  Board  may  make  rules  of
procedure for the exercise, discharge and performance of its
powers, functions and duties.
(11) The rules of procedure may provide for the manner
in which the meetings of the Monetary Policy Board shall
be  conducted.
(12) The minutes of each meeting of the Monetary Policy
Board  shall  be  kept  in  writing,  and  retained  at  least  for  a
period of twelve years.
(13) No act, decision or proceeding of the Monetary Policy
Board shall be deemed to be invalid by reason only of the
existence of any vacancy in the Monetary Policy Board or
any defect in the appointment of any member of the Monetary
Policy Board.

14.
(1) There shall be an Executive Board of the Central
Bank (in this Act referred to as the “Executive Board”) which
is  charged  with  the  day-to-day  operations  of  the  Central
Bank.
(2) The Executive Board shall consist of the Governor of
the  Central  Bank  who  shall  be  the  Chairperson  of  the
Executive Board, the Senior Deputy Governor of the Central
Bank and the other Deputy Governors of the Central Bank.
